title: Why Most AI Strategies Fail Before They Start
excerpt: The three foundational mistakes organisations make when approaching AI — and how to avoid them.
contentText: AI strategies often fail because organisations treat AI as a technology problem rather than a business transformation challenge.

title: From Pilot to Production: Scaling GenAI Responsibly
excerpt: Moving beyond the proof-of-concept graveyard requires a different kind of organisational muscle.
contentText: Scaling GenAI from pilot to production requires deliberate investment in data governance, model monitoring, and cross-functional alignment.

title: The Board Questions Every CTO Needs to Be Ready For
excerpt: As AI moves from IT project to board agenda item, executive teams need clear answers to hard questions.
contentText: Board members increasingly ask about AI risk, cost, and competitive positioning. CTOs must be prepared to answer with clarity and confidence.
